## Setup checklist
1. Open **Call Apify 2GIS Actor** and replace `YOUR_APIFY_TOKEN` with a real Apify API token.
2. Confirm the actor ID in **Build Apify Request** — defaults to `thenetaji~2gis-place-scraper` (apify.com/thenetaji/2gis-place-scraper). Swap it for whichever 2GIS actor you're using.
3. **The actor input body (`searchStringsArray`/`locationQuery`/`maxCrawledPlaces`) is a best-effort guess** — this was drafted without live access to apify.com to confirm the actor's real Input schema. Run a test execution; if it errors or returns nothing, open the actor's "API" tab on Apify for its real input JSON and edit the `actorInput` object in **Build Apify Request** to match.
4. **Map to Whizz Contacts** tries several likely field names per contact (title/name, phone/phoneNumber/phones[0], etc.) since the actor's exact output field names are equally unverified — adjust there too if real output looks different.

Whizz calls this at POST https://n8n.aiingo.com/webhook/whizz-discover-2gis with body {query, location, brand, category, limit} and expects back {"contacts":[{name,phone,email,website,address,totalScore,url}]}.
